mentions.name: purio
mentions.description: This Android app helps people quit smoking by serving as a deflection/distraction during the beginning and hard times of quitting.
mentions.problem: The author stopped smoking at Sylvester and needed something to deflect from the hard early period of quitting.
mentions.source_excerpt: At Sylvester I stopped smoking.for the beginning and hard times I searched for a deflection and started with my own quitesmoke app - purio
